name: compact-stepper
title: Compact stepper
description: A stepper for small spaces: 'Step 2 of 5, Shipping' over a segmented bar, with the full list of steps and their states one tap away.
docs: steps is the list of { id, label, description, state, href } and current the index of the step in progress, counted from 0. A step before current is done and one after it is upcoming; set state to 'error' on a step that needs attention. The top line is the counter and the name of the current step ('Step 2 of 5', 'Shipping') in one polite live region, so moving on is announced once; a current step in error also says 'Needs attention' beside its name. Under it a segmented bar has one segment per step: done is a mid grey, the current one is solid and upcoming ones are faint, and the bar is hidden from assistive technology because the text already says it. The All steps button opens a popover, a dialog named 'All steps', with every step, its description and its state in words (Done, Current, Needs attention); the state word sits beside the name and the description has the full width of the row under it. With allowJumpBack, done steps and steps in error before the current one become links in that list when they have an href or you give onStepSelect (a button, or an anchor when the step has an href), and choosing one calls onStepSelect(id, index) and closes the list; upcoming steps and the current one are always plain text. A stepper that is read-only, or whose steps have an href and no onStepSelect, can be rendered from a Server Component; onStepSelect is a function and needs a client parent. A step in error that is not the current one is also named under the bar ('Payment needs attention'). size is md or sm, and labels holds every word for another language. It works in any width, from a 240px column to a full-width header.
